# This is the ESP-IDF project that builds just the second-stage bootloader.
#
# No `main` component is needed: `idf.py bootloader` builds only the
# bootloader subproject.  `sdkconfig.defaults` is generated by the Nix
# derivation (default.nix), not checked in.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

include($ENV{IDF_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)
project(esp32c3_bootloader)
